div.div: شِبْعٌ a subst., signifying A thing that satiates one, sates one, or satisfies one's stomach; (S, Msb, K;) consisting of bread, and of flesh-meat, &c.; (Msb;) as also ↓ شِبَعٌ : (K:) accord. to some, the former is an inf. n.: (Msb:) or it is an inf. n. and also a subst. signifying as above. (TA.) You say, الرَّغِيفُ شِبْعِى The cake of bread [is that which] satiates me, &c. (Msb.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
